en: Nope. That's the first I've heard of it.
You didn't hear that one? They said it was under the land where Kamurocho Hills went up, but I guess there wasn't any truth to it.
Maybe instead of wasting your time chasing urban legends, you could get a job.
The match going on in the Coliseum now isn't even worth watching. It's too one-sided.
If that's the best you can do and you still decide to go into the Coliseum, you better not cry when you get your shit kicked in.
I hear they finally completed Kamurocho Hills. It's kind of amazing they pulled it off, especially when you think about all the complications they had with the project.
Yeah. I wonder what happened to all the homeless that were living there, though. They're really cleaning up the city lately.
All right! Got your ticket?
Hell yeah I do!
Yay! I can't believe we got seats! I don't even care that they're kind of off to the side. Let's get things started!
Did you hear about that Dream Line thing?
Yeah! Talk about out of the blue!
I want to go so bad! I hope we can find a way to get tickets!
How come T-Set is doing a concert at the dome, and Haruka-chan's got canceled!?
Well, it's a nice surprise for me, but I can't help but wonder what happened. Think there will still be tickets available?
Damn, that Dream Line thing took me by surprise.
So there weren't any rumors floating about the industry about it?
Not a peep. They must've kept a pretty tight lid on it. That's Katsuya for you.
You don't think you were just left out of the loop?
No one saw that T-Set concert coming. Katsuya really knows how to work his angle.
What about Haruka Sawamura? She had all that good press after winning the Princess League. Is she just going to fade away?
Who knows? It sounds like she's signed up for a tiny production agency whose president offed herself not too long ago. I'm betting her career's over.
Wow. The industry's a cruel world...
I saw the president of T-Set's agency on TV. I think his name's Katsuya? Ugh, he's hot as hell.
Totally. I hear he's staying at that really expensive hotel in Kamurocho Hills.
Wow. I'd straight-up kill someone to spend the night with him there...
Huh? All the stores are closed today for "emergency maintenance"? What the hell?
What kind of maintenance would shut down all these stores? This really puts a wrench into my plans.
If all the stores are closed, why'd those guys go in just now?
They didn't look like maintenance men. My guess is yakuza.
Like I said, right, there's emergency maintenance. Huh? How am I supposed to know?
Anyway, it doesn't look like we'll get into the Hills today. Yeah, let's meet at Karaokekan.
It's not fair! I was really looking forward to going out today!
It's all right. We'll just have to shop somewhere else now. How about Le Marche? You said you were looking for a handbag, right?
I guess... But only because you're so sweet, Hide-kun.
Grr... I caved and bought Dream Line tickets from a scalper.
Apparently I have to pick them up at the venue. I might punch the guy when I see him, though. There goes this month's paycheck...
Shit, I can't find any Dream Line tickets.
There are a few for sale online, but there's no way I'm paying that kind of money. I hope those fucking resellers die in a fire!
Did you see the news about Dream Line?
Yeah, I did! They're all super cute! I think I'll copy Mai-chan's hairstyle next time I get mine styled!
Really? I like Haruka's style better.
Sorry, I don't think I'll be able to get you any Dream Line tickets...
Oh, well. It's not like I'm that that interested in them, anyway. Guess I'll just have to hit up a hostess club instead.
Uh, sure, okay. I'll make reservations.
Hey, isn't there any way you can get me some Dream Line tickets?
I mean, I can try, but it's probably gonna be tough...
I thought you knew someone who worked at that event company, right? C'mon, call in a favor, for me, yeah?
I guess I could try talking to them, but I'm pretty sure it won't do any good...
Ya remembered the tickets, right?
Yeah, I ain't gonna forget those. Man, I didn't see this one comin'. But here we are in Tokyo!
Who woulda guessed our first trip to Tokyo would be to see our darlings perform on stage? I'm so happy I could cry.
Well, we better go start linin' up for merch. I guess we go by train from here?
Yeah. Japan Dome, here we come!

んスが、それにちょっとお得な情報がありまして。
So ya don't have a boyfriend, Haruka-chan?
Ain't that kinda sad at your age? Back in my hayday, I was fightin' 'em off left and right.
Y'know, I used to be quite the bad boy. Baddest on the block.
Everyone wanted to be with the coolest, toughest dude back in high school. That's why they all flocked straight to me.
After school, they'd pretend to run into me at the gate and be like, "Hey, ya wanna hang out?"
I couldn't just turn 'em down, so off we went.
Then we'd head behind the school, and a bunch of guys'd beat me up.
Wait, there's more. Every mornin' when I went to open my locker...
I'd swing it open and <Italic>BAM</Italic>! An avalanche of love letters would come floodin' out!
All of 'em said pretty much the same thing. "Please, I want ya to be my..."
"Sparring partner."
There were others. One said, "From the moment I laid eyes on ya, you're all I can think about!"
"I love everything about you. That sultry voice, those devilish eyes, those moist lips."
And he ended it with, "Please go out with me."
But after all that, we only lasted a year.
Long story short, I've never had a girlfriend.
Haruka-chan, what's your dream job?
Really? Me, I wanna be a superhero.
Well, when I grow up, I'm gonna be a superhero no matter what!
No, I mean I'm gonna keep growin' till I'm really, <Italic>really</Italic> big!
Once I'm super ginormous, I'll start runnin' amok. Smashin' buildings n' the like.
And I'll shoot red-hot laser beams from my eyes and breathe fire from my mouth!
Ya got it all wrong. I'm sayin' I'm gonna be a superhero.
I got this fire for justice burnin' in my chest.
N' when I'm in trouble, I'll let it out and turn everythin' to ash!
Wait, there's more. The army's missiles and whatnot won't have any effect on me. I'll even be impervious to their new laser cannon!
But I am! I'm a superhero! A champion of justice!
'Course, it wouldn't be very interestin' if I were invincible.
Naturally, I'd have one key weakness.
I'd be weak to girls.
Just one look at a female monster, and it'd be all over for me.
I'd get so hot and bothered, I wouldn't be able to control myself.
Finally, all the tension would make me explode! And that would be the end of me.
So I've been thinkin' about takin' up a new hobby.
Figure I might as well do somethin' the ladies think is cool. Maybe motorcycles or somethin'.
I could go up to a girl I liked and say, "How 'bout a spin, just you n' me?"
Then I'd say something like, "Let's become one with the wind." Pretty cool, right?
But what I really mean is, "Our bodies are gonna be one."
"I wanna hear your engine roar."
"I'm gonna go full throttle on ya!"
But motorcycles are great, huh? You can really get up close and personal with your girl.
She can't help snuggling up close to you because the seat's so small.
The two of us, bodies pressed together, feelin' the wind on our skin... I get all hot and bothered just thinkin' about it!
And my girl would feel my heart racin' as I press up against her back.
Well, yeah. I don't have a motorcycle license.
Ya know what a sidecar is? Those little things that attach to the side of a motorcycle?
'Parently you can use one with just a car license.
I hear it feels great wheelin' around in a sidecar.
The two of us would go around turns, balancin' with each other. It'd be some real teamwork.
Just like our teamwork in the sack!
